description: 熊熊姿勢池：身體姿勢層（與造型/風格/質感/構圖/條件獨立）。控制熊熊在畫面中的姿勢，不限定四足。

poses.en: standing on all four legs with its head raised, alert and steady
sitting on its haunches with its front paws resting together in front of its chest
lying on its side with its legs stretched out and its head resting on the ground
lying flat on its belly with its chin resting on its front paws
crouching low with its haunches tucked under its body and its front paws planted on the ground
bounding forward at full speed with all four limbs extended in mid-stride
leaping into the air with all four limbs lifted clear of the ground
gliding through the air with its limbs stretched back behind it
playfully batting a ball with its front paws while half-rearing on its hind legs
rolling over on its back in playful bliss with its paws in the air
lowering its head to drink from a shallow pool with its front paws braced on the rim
curled up asleep with its limbs tucked beneath its body
climbing a tree trunk with its front paws gripping the bark
swimming with its head above the water and its limbs paddling beneath the surface
stretching luxuriously with its front legs extended forward and its rear raised
sniffing the air with its head lifted and its muzzle tilted upward
